name: Clone Probe
description: Proof that an APPENDED creature row loads in game. creatures.GDA has carried exactly 128 rows in every build so far; this adds row 128 and puts it in the opening area. The row is a Gizoid's model, portrait and robot class carrying Wild Boar's level-2 stats (45 HP, 8 POW), so the first Wild Boar in Green Hill is a knee-high Gizoid. Its POW moves are blanked deliberately: Quake Punch does 75 damage and Sonic starts on 33 HP, so a transplanted move would one-shot the party before the test told us anything. Moves come later, once combo rows can be cloned and rescaled too.
